title: Sumo Wrestling Ducks
prompt:
Create a 3D sumo wrestling game using Three.js where two duck characters compete in a circular ring. Load the duck model from 'Duck.glb' using GLTFLoader (from CDN: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.163.0/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js). Use Three.js from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.163.0/build/three.module.js as ES module.

SCENE SETUP:
- Create a circular sumo ring (dohyo) as a cylinder with radius 5, height 0.3, colored sandy brown (#DEB887) centered at origin. Add a white ring border (torus) at the edge radius 5.
- Place a ground plane beneath the ring colored dark green.
- Camera: perspective at position (0, 8, 12) looking at origin.
- Lighting: ambient light (intensity 0.5) + directional light from (5, 10, 5) with intensity 1.0.
- Load Duck.glb TWICE: once for the player (blue tinted, left side at x=-2, z=0) and once for the AI opponent (red tinted, right side at x=2, z=0). Scale ducks to 2.0. Player duck faces right (+x), AI duck faces left (-x).

PHYSICS & GAME MECHANICS:
- Each duck has: position {x,z}, velocity {x,z}, mass=1.0, health=100, stamina=100.
- Movement is on the XZ plane. Ducks cannot go below ring surface (y stays on ring level).
- Player controls with WASD keys for movement (acceleration 0.5 units/frame). Max speed 0.15 units/frame.
- SPACE key = charge/push attack: applies force in facing direction, costs 20 stamina. Has 500ms cooldown.
- Stamina regenerates at 2 per second when not attacking.
- When ducks collide (distance < 1.2), they push each other based on relative velocity and mass. The one moving faster pushes the other more.
- Apply friction of 0.92 per frame to velocities.
- A duck is 'out' if its distance from center > 5.0 (outside ring). This scores a point for the opponent.
- After ring-out, reset both ducks to starting positions. First to 3 points wins.

AI OPPONENT:
- AI moves toward player at 60% player speed.
- AI attacks when within distance 2.0 of player, with 1.5 second cooldown.
- AI tries to stay near center when far from player.

HUD / UI:
- Display at top: 'Player: X - AI: Y' score in large white text with black shadow.
- Health bars for each duck below the score.
- Stamina bar for player (blue bar) below health.
- Show 'ROUND X' text briefly (2 seconds) at start of each round.
- When a player wins (3 points), show 'PLAYER WINS!' or 'AI WINS!' overlay with a 'Restart' button (id='restartBtn').
- Add a 'Start Game' button (id='startBtn') that begins the match. Game starts in 'waiting' state.
- Show a small FPS counter in top-right corner.

STATE MANAGEMENT - expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- gameState: 'waiting' | 'countdown' | 'playing' | 'roundEnd' | 'gameOver'
- playerScore: number (0-3)
- aiScore: number (0-3)
- playerPos: {x, z} current position
- aiPos: {x, z} current position
- playerStamina: number (0-100)
- aiStamina: number (0-100)
- playerVelocity: {x, z}
- aiVelocity: {x, z}
- roundNumber: number (starts at 1)
- playerDistFromCenter: number (computed)
- aiDistFromCenter: number (computed)
- winner: null | 'player' | 'ai'
- lastCollisionTime: timestamp or 0
- playerAttacking: boolean
- modelsLoaded: boolean (true when both ducks loaded)
- ringRadius: 5.0

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop. Ensure all numeric values are never NaN.
physics_constraints: Friction coefficient 0.92/frame. Max speed 0.15 units/frame. Ring radius 5.0 for out-of-bounds. Collision distance threshold 1.2 units. Stamina costs 20 per attack, regenerates 2/sec. Push force proportional to relative velocity on collision.
